description: List available data types (measurement labels like TMAX, TMIN, PRCP, SNOW) for a given dataset or category. Pass a datasetId to see what is measured in that dataset, or a datacategoryId (e.g., "TEMP") to see all temperature-related types. Hundreds of types exist across all datasets. Use this before calling noaa_climate_fetch_data when the data type IDs are unknown. Common GHCND types: TMAX (max temperature), TMIN (min temperature), PRCP (precipitation), SNOW (snowfall), SNWD (snow depth), AWND (average wind speed).

datacategoryId.description: Filter to data types in this category (e.g., "TEMP" for temperature types, "PRCP" for precipitation). Optional.

datasetId.description: Filter to data types available in this dataset (e.g., "GHCND", "GSOM"). Optional.

endDate.description: Filter to data types with data on or before this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–1000). Defaults to 25.

locationId.description: Filter to data types available at this location ID. Optional.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first result to return for pagination. Defaults to 0.

sortField.description: Sort results by this field. Optional.

sortOrder.description: Sort direction. Optional; defaults to asc.

startDate.description: Filter to data types with data on or after this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional.

stationId.description: Filter to data types available at this station ID. Optional.

name: noaa_climate_list_data_types

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `service_unavailable`: NOAA CDO API is unreachable or returning errors. `rate_limited`: NOAA CDO throttled the request — the configured token went over its rate limit. `upstream_auth_failed`: NOAA CDO rejected the API token this server is configured with. `validation_error`: A filter parameter is not recognized by the NOAA CDO API (e.g., unknown datacategoryId or datasetId). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

exhausted.description: True when the requested offset is past the end of a non-empty result set — the page is empty but matches exist. Omitted otherwise.

metadata.description: Pagination metadata. Present when the API returns it.

resultset.description: Pagination cursor fields for this response.

count.description: Total number of matching data types.

limit.description: Page size used for this response.

offset.description: Zero-based starting index of this page, echoing the requested offset.

notice.description: Guidance when no data types matched — echoes applied filters and suggests how to broaden.

datacoverage.description: Fractional data coverage (0–1). Omitted when not provided by the API.

id.description: Data type ID (e.g., TMAX, TMIN, PRCP).

maxdate.description: Latest date this data type is available (YYYY-MM-DD). Omitted when not provided.

mindate.description: Earliest date this data type is available (YYYY-MM-DD). Omitted when not provided.

totalCount.description: Total number of matching data types before the page limit.

title: List NOAA Climate Data Types
